title: Case REQ-20261103-LIF001 — Statement of Advice summary
content:
Summary of the Statement of Advice for Priya Natarajan (CL-104582), case REQ-20261103-LIF001. Drafted by the Paraplanning Agent's SoA Drafting assistant for Penny (Paraplanning) on Thu 5 Nov 2026; reviewed and signed by Amelia, Senior Risk Adviser, on Fri 6 Nov 2026. The advice is Amelia's.

Scope: personal and family protection for Priya — life, TPD, trauma and income protection. Arjun's cover is not in scope.

Advice: Corella Life policy with life cover of $750,000 and any-occupation TPD of $600,000 inside Corella Life's super plan (premiums funded by a rollover from Riverbend Super); an own-occupation TPD extension outside super, linked to the super cover; trauma cover of $150,000 and income protection of $6,125 a month (90-day waiting period, benefit period to age 65) outside super. Stepped premiums.

Best-interests steps recorded (Corporations Act s961B(2)): Priya's objectives, finances and needs from the fact find; the subject matter of the advice and her relevant circumstances; reasonable inquiries about her existing cover with Riverbend Super and Kestrel Retail Super; Amelia's expertise in personal protection advice; a reasonable investigation of products across the APL ('Case REQ-20261103-LIF001 — insurer quotes'); judgements based on Priya's circumstances (her occupation, health, mortgage, children and budget); and keeping her existing cover so the family is never without cover.

Existing cover: the Riverbend Super cover ($210,000) stays in place. The Kestrel Retail Super cover ($50,000) stops on 30 Nov 2026 unless Priya elects to keep it: Amelia recommends she keeps it until the new cover is in force. No existing cover is replaced or cancelled by this advice; any later decision about the Kestrel cover is Priya's, with Amelia.

Premiums: $3,180 in year 1 (stepped) — $858 a year inside super and $2,322 a year outside super ($193.50 a month from cash flow, within her $300-a-month budget). The level-premium option was $4,050 in year 1.

Fees and commission, in dollars (see 'Caldova Life Advice — Financial Services Guide and remuneration' and 'Commission rules — LIF caps, clawback and consent'):
• advice fee: $0 — Caldova charges no advice fee for protection-only advice
• upfront commission from Corella Life: 60% of the first-year policy cost of $3,180 = $1,908
• ongoing commission: 20% of the policy cost each year from year 2 — $636 a year on a policy cost of $3,180, changing as the premium changes
Commission figures exclude GST; the LIF caps are tested on the commission excluding GST. If the policy is cancelled in year 1, Corella recovers 100% of the upfront commission from Caldova, and 60% if it is cancelled in year 2 (pro-rated if the cover is reduced instead).

Commission consent (s963BB): before Priya consented, the SoA disclosed the insurer, the commission rates as a percentage of the policy cost, how often and for how long the commission is paid (each year the policy continues), Caldova's services (annual reviews and claims support), that the law requires her consent, and that her consent is irrevocable. Priya gave her written consent with the SoA and received a copy.

Warnings: answer every application question with reasonable care; don't cancel any existing cover until the new cover is in force; a 14-day cooling-off period applies once the policy is issued.

Second review: lump-sum cover totals $1,500,000, under $2,000,000, so no second review was needed.

Authority to Proceed: signed by Priya on Sat 7 Nov 2026.
